prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity dark desktop portfolio landing-page direction comp, 1536 by 1024 landscape
Primary request: Design an unmistakably non-generic responsive website viewport for COLTON SPURGIN as a night cross-check system. Six calm instruments each hold one truth; together they describe the person you can trust when conditions are unclear. Use instrument logic without cockpit cosplay.
Scene/backdrop: no scene; flat front-facing dark website interface
Subject: a candid portfolio for an Air Force NCO, lead software developer intern, research assistant, and UWF senior specializing in AI graduating December 2026, who wants to build useful ambitious software and pursue a master’s degree
Style/medium: high-fidelity near-black web UI with six luminous semantic instruments, physical bezels, radium-green markings, crisp aviation numerals, and terse placard typography; sober, quiet, trustworthy
Composition/framing: a slim top placard carries COLTON SPURGIN at left and WORK, EXPERIENCE, ABOUT, CONTACT at right. Beneath it, the viewport is one fixed two-row constellation of six large but restrained instruments, not cards. Instrument 1 is a typographic attitude indicator holding the statement “BUILD USEFUL THINGS. STAY CURIOUS. OWN THE RESULT.” Instrument 2 is SERVICE and reads AIR FORCE NCO. Instrument 3 is SOFTWARE and reads LEAD SOFTWARE DEVELOPER INTERN. Instrument 4 is RESEARCH and reads RESEARCH ASSISTANT. Instrument 5 is STUDY and reads AI SPECIALIZATION · UWF · DEC 2026. Instrument 6 is WORK and uses a four-position selector labeled BORK, VELLM, TSP BENCHMARKS, HOME LAB. A subtle luminous sweep line connects the instruments in reading order. The lower placard carries VIEW THE WORK and START A CONVERSATION. Each instrument owns one truth and shows a calm stable state; no fake measurements.
Color palette: panel black #050706, luminous white #e9efe9, radium green #73d68a, caution amber #c77b25, bezel graphite #282d2a
Materials/textures: matte instrument panel, restrained brushed-metal bezels, luminous painted markings, tactile placards
Text (verbatim): “COLTON SPURGIN”; “WORK”; “EXPERIENCE”; “ABOUT”; “CONTACT”; “BUILD USEFUL THINGS. STAY CURIOUS. OWN THE RESULT.”; “SERVICE”; “AIR FORCE NCO”; “SOFTWARE”; “LEAD SOFTWARE DEVELOPER INTERN”; “RESEARCH”; “RESEARCH ASSISTANT”; “STUDY”; “AI SPECIALIZATION · UWF · DEC 2026”; “WORK”; “BORK”; “VELLM”; “TSP BENCHMARKS”; “HOME LAB”; “VIEW THE WORK”; “START A CONVERSATION”
Constraints: this must read as a functional dark desktop website and a semantic personal cross-check, not a literal cockpit or aviation product; all core copy legible; no portrait, logo, aircraft, flags, rank insignia, fake data, invented metrics, employers, awards, testimonials, or project claims
Avoid: full cockpit scene, photoreal airplane interior, military cosplay, HUD, radar, generic hero plus card grid, bento grid, cyberpunk neon, terminal UI, beige editorial portfolio, rounded cards, glassmorphism, 3D device mockup, browser chrome, illegible pseudo-text, watermark
